title: Coach Sync: AE+CSM Account Playbook — Prep (Harper)
content:
Meeting: Weekly coach sync (AE + CSM) — 30m
When: Thu 2026-03-14 10:00-10:30 PT (link: https://meet.redwood.ai/harper-coach-sync)
Attendees: Harper (CSM), Marcus (AE), Priya (AE backup)
Purpose: Quick triage of top accounts, align on renewal/expansion asks, unblock escalations before Friday customer demos. Short, tactical — prioritize 3 accounts and 1 operational improvement.
---
Top objectives for this sync
- Confirm next-step commitments for ACME, VeloTech, & BrightHealth ahead of exec demo and renewal window.
- Surface anything needing ops/infra help (SRE/Support) so I can open an escalation before EOD.
- Agree on owner + due dates for playbook updates and enablement for Marcus before customer calls.
---
Context notes (brief)
1) ACME Corp (Strategic, $420k ARR)
   - Renewal window: 2026-05-20 (Q2 close)
   - Current health: Fair — usage plateauing, 1 P0 latenct incident last month (model timeout on peak annotator job).
   - Recent ask: Concern about token costs and occasional latency spikes. Want committed predictability or autoscaling guarantees.
   - Internal: Eng ticket JIRA-2298 (KV cache tuning) in progress; infra says fix targeted for 2026-03-22.
   - Goal for meeting: Get Marcus to surface exec ask (cost predictability) and confirm we can offer a dedicated burst policy trial for 60 days.
   - Proposed talking points: outline dedicated capacity vs hosted cost model, suggest Optimize audit (one-off) + follow-up eval set.
   - Risk: If we don’t show a plan for cost containment before next exec call, renewal probability drops 30%.

2) VeloTech (Mid-market, $95k ARR)
   - Renewal window: 2026-04-05 (renewal in 3 weeks)
   - Health: Good adoption of embeddings; only blocker is integration with their search proxy (CORS + routing).
   - Recent: Support thread #SL-1041 — engineering provided workaround but they want a timeline for permanent fix.
   - Goal: Marcus to propose a prioritized punch list and commit to a support SLA (response time + deployment ETA).
   - Action: Offer a dedicated support hours block (4 hours) from Solutions Eng this sprint to finish proxy integration.

3) BrightHealth (Expansion opportunity, $60k ARR current, potential +$150k)
   - Health: High NPS for baseline features, feature request: private deployment (gov cloud) for PHI concern.
   - Roadblock: Legal/Compliance interaction needed to qualify shareable artifact for privacy controls.
   - Goal: Decide if we open Private deployment exploratory (pre-sales checklist) and who owns the legal intake.
   - Next step: Harper to run intake with security-compliance (confluence page linked).

Operational item: Playbook hygiene + enablement
- Marcus needs an abbreviated playbook slide (2 slides) for each key account clarifying current config, outstanding tickets, and ask. Target: 1 slide per account by Tue 2026-03-19.
- Harper will create a short checklist template (playbook-v2) and circulate.
---
Draft meeting agenda (30m)
1) Quick updates (3 min) — wins and new risks
2) ACME focused triage (10 min) — decide escalation & trial offer
3) VeloTech renewal readiness (8 min) — timeline for fix + owner
4) BrightHealth expansion triage (5 min) — qualification for Private deployment
5) Quick ops asks & next actions (4 min)
---
Anticipated Qs & suggested replies
- Q: Customer asks for hard SLA on latency.
  A: We can commit to an SLA for Dedicated or Reserved pools; for Hosted we offer SLO/incident credits and a fallback runbook. Suggest trial of Dedicated burst for 60 days to demonstrate stability.
- Q: Can we reduce token costs quickly?
  A: Short-term: prompt engineering and caching. Medium-term: model quantization/alternate model routing. Offer Redwood Optimize audit (2-week scoped).
---
Open blockers (things I may ask Marcus to confirm in meeting)
- Who owns the exec deck update for ACME? (Marcus?)
- Do we have capacity to spin a 60-day dedicated burst pool for ACME in EU-west? (Confirm w/ infra — pinged #infra, awaiting reply)
- Is Solutions Eng available next Thu for VeloTech proxy follow-up? (Priya to confirm)
---
Action items (clear, owner, due)
- Harper: Draft playbook checklist + template and upload to Confluence (linked) — due 2026-03-16.
- Marcus: Create 2-slide account snapshot for ACME & VeloTech and share before the meeting — due 2026-03-13 EOD.
- Priya: Confirm Solutions Eng availability for 4h block and add to calendar — due 2026-03-15.
- Harper: If infra capacity confirmed, open JIRA escalation for ACME dedicated burst (JIRA-2314 placeholder) — due 2026-03-14.
- Harper: Run legal intake for BrightHealth private deployment request, assemble summary for next sync — due 2026-03-20.
---
Notes to self (quick reminders)
- Keep the sync tight — focus on commitments we can deliver in 2 weeks.
- Bring numbers: current token spend for ACME (need finance slice) — ask finance for last 30-day token breakdown.
- If Marcus raises possible churn signal for ACME, escalate to AM and set up 1:1 with Head of CS.
---
Post-meeting follow-up template (copy below into calendar event)
- Short summary of decisions + owners + due dates.
- Links: playbook, JIRA tickets, support threads.
- Ask: any objections to proposed trial/offer (48h window)
---
Quick links for meeting
- ACME playbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/ACME-Playbook-Draft
- Infra ticket: JIRA-2298 (KV cache tuning)
- Support thread: https://support.redwood.ai/t/SL-1041

End of prep notes.

(If time: draft a one-paragraph internal summary to drop in the customer-facing exec prep doc after meeting.)
